WITH counts_per_type AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
), type_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count
  FROM counts_per_type
), above_average AS (
  SELECT c.order_count, a.avg_count
  FROM counts_per_type AS c
  CROSS JOIN type_average AS a
  WHERE c.order_count > a.avg_count
)
SELECT AVG(order_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(order_count - avg_count) AS average_excess
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: The average across types gives each order type with at least one matched order equal weight; order types with zero matched orders are absent because they have no rows in the matched data.
